newsitem.title: USA: Wilsons The Leather Experts allotment exercised.
newsitem.headline: Wilsons The Leather Experts allotment exercised.

text.p: Wilsons The Leather Experts Inc said Equity Securities Investments Inc, the underwriter of its recent initial public offering, exercised its right to acquire an additional 165,000 units at $9.00 per unit to the public.
In its initial public offering, the company sold 1,100,000 units, consisting of 1,100,000 shares of common stock and 1,100,000 redeemable stock purchase warrants.

The company said it plans to use the net proceeds from the offering and the over-allotment exercise to fund anticipated capital expenditures, including building new stores, remodeling existing stores, developing and implementing new information systems, testing new business concepts and for working capital purposes.
Wilsons is a specialty retailer of men's and women's leather outerwear, apparel and accessories, operating 451 stores in 45 states, the District of Columbia and England.
